subject: Grafana + Datadog telemetry playbook for Redwood runtime integration
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@grafana.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@datadog.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + observability playbook for Redwood runtime

Hi Stephanie,

Great to meet at KubeCon — thanks for the quick chat about how Redwood surfaces runtime telemetry. Grafana Labs is very interested in a lightweight integration that makes it easy for your customers to:

- Export key metrics (inference latency p50/p95, token throughput, active sessions) into OpenTelemetry/Prometheus-compatible endpoints
- Ship traces for cold-starts and fallback routing decisions to Tempo/Jaeger
- Provide a first-run Grafana dashboard and alerting pack that customers can import

Marco from Datadog is cc'd because we think a joint docs + demo approach (Grafana dashboards + Datadog synthetic/trace checks) will help reach enterprise customers faster.

Do you have a short technical contact at Redwood we can pair with for an initial requirements doc and a mutual action plan? I'll attach a quick example playbook and a checklist of what we typically need (API endpoints, metrics schema, auth options).

Best,
Olivia Park
Strategic Partner Manager – Observability
Grafana Labs

Attachments: grafana-observability-playbook-sample.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@grafana.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + observability playbook for Redwood runtime

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and for looping Marco in.

Chloe (solutions engineering) and Marcus (integrations PM) are the right folks to scope the telemetry surface and the mutual action plan.

High level constraints from our side:
- Customer-facing SDKs must be optional (we prefer to surface metrics from the serving runtime with an OTLP endpoint that can be pulled or pushed)
- We need an initial dashboard pack that supports both short sequences (chat style) and long-context generation jobs
- Data retention and sample rates (we commonly offer 7/30/90 day retention tiers) will be important for enterprise SLAs

Can we align on a two-week POC: week 1 — instrumentation + agreement on metrics/otlp schema; week 2 — dashboard + alert templates and a co-demo?

I attached an integration map and a short OTEL schema proposal to get the ball rolling.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships (Observability Alliances)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-grafana-integration-map.pdf, otel-schema-proposal.md

From: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@datadog.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@grafana.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + observability playbook for Redwood runtime

Hi Chloe / Stephanie — happy to collaborate. A couple of quick notes from Datadog's side:

1) Metrics: we typically ingest via OTLP/Prometheus scrape or via our Agent. For high-volume token telemetry we recommend a summarized metric stream (e.g., per-model per-node aggregated counters every 10s) to avoid cardinality explosion.
2) Tracing: we can accept full spans for latency-critical operations but we'd like a sampling strategy for lower-value requests (e.g., sampling 1% of inference calls, higher for error cases).
3) Security & PII: any request-level logs that include user prompts should be redacted before shipping unless the customer explicitly opts in.

We can run a quick workshop to align on metrics names/labels. Marco (me) and Olivia — can you review the proposed mutual-action-plan.xlsx attached by Stephanie and add a column for Datadog deliverables?

Cheers,
Marco Rossi
Strategic Partnerships, Observability Integrations
Datadog

Attachments: none

From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@grafana.com>, Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@datadog.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + observability playbook for Redwood runtime

Thanks — quick technical questions before the workshop:

1) Auth: will partners prefer mutual TLS to an OTLP endpoint, or token-based (API key) push? We support both but need to confirm provisioning flow for customer-managed endpoints.
2) Metric schema: draft below (we attached otel-schema-proposal.md). Please confirm if Datadog/Grafana need different label sets. Example metrics:
   - redwood.inference.tokens_total{model,region,customer_id}
   - redwood.inference.latency_ms_p50/p95{model,region,customer_id,route}
   - redwood.kv_cache.hit_ratio{model,region}
3) Dashboards: we propose 1) service summary, 2) model performance breakdown, 3) SLA exceptions/alerts. For Grafana we will provide JSON dashboards; for Datadog we will provide dashboard JSON + synthetic checks.

Proposed workshop slots (PT): Thu Jul 3 10:00 or Fri Jul 4 14:00. If those don't work, propose alternatives next week.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-redwood-grafana.xlsx, otel-schema-proposal.md

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@grafana.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@datadog.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + observability playbook for Redwood runtime

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround. Fri Jul 4 is a holiday for part of my team; we can do Thu Jul 3 10:00 PT and have Marco join remotely.

Answers to Chloe's Qs in brief:
- Auth: mutual TLS preferred for enterprise-managed endpoints, API-key push OK for smaller customers; Grafana Cloud supports both.
- Labels: the schema looks good — add a "deployment_type" label (hosted|dedicated|private) so dashboards can pivot on customer deployment mode.
- Sampling: agree with Datadog's approach — provide high-fidelity traces for errors and sampled traces for latency profiling.

Next steps:
1) Chloe / Marcus add expected Redwood deliverables to the MAP (week-by-week).
2) Grafana will prepare a starter dashboard pack and a short co-demo script.
3) Confirm security checklist (we'll use the SignalPath consult for an ATO playbook).

I'll upload a starter dashboard pack and a short draft mutual-action-plan to the Drive link shared. Also happy to provide partner logos and an intro blurb for co-marketing once we have a signed technical MOU.

Best,
Olivia Park
Strategic Partner Manager – Observability
Grafana Labs

Attachments: grafana-starter-dashboard-pack.zip
